import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    n = int(line.strip())
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    if n == 1:
        print(2)
        return
    
    # dp[i] = number of ways to build i buildings where last building is blue
    # rp[i] = number of ways to build i buildings where last building is red
    
    # Base cases
    # n=1: B or R -> dp[1] = 1, rp[1] = 1
    
    prev_dp = 1   # dp[1]
    prev_rp = 1   # rp[1]
    
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        # To end with blue: previous can be anything
        curr_dp = (prev_dp + prev_rp) % MOD
        # To end with red: previous must be red (consecutive reds)
        # or previous can be blue, then we have one red
        if i == 2:
            curr_rp = prev_rp  # only rp[1] ways
        else:
            curr_rp = (prev_rp + prev_dp) % MOD
        
        prev_dp = curr_dp
        prev_rp = curr_rp
    
    print((prev_dp + prev_rp) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
